name: Multiplicative Isomorphism
description: Translated the additive 1D geometric constraints into a multiplicative algebraic system by applying an exponential map ($V = U \cdot 2^p$). The non-overlapping constraint becomes a quadratic inequality $(V_i - U_k)(V_k - U_i) \le 0$. This preserves the exact logical structure and answers, but destroys geometric heuristics. Models that pattern-match to "sum of lengths" will compute $\sum (2^p - 1)$ and fail, while models that genuinely reason will discover that the invariant is $\prod 2^p = 2^{\sum p}$, leading them back to $\sum p > T$.
